name: Sofia Rossi
psychographics: Prioritises manual control; enjoys the tactile feel of paper and cash; wary of always-on connectivity.
current_solutions: Uses a physical planner and notebook for work; pays rent via bank transfer only; refuses to use Instagram or TikTok.
frustration: Attempted to book a dentist appointment at 11:00am via the surgery's portal; the form auto-filled her old address from three years ago, and the confirmation email never arrived, leaving her uncertain if the booking went through.
decision_style: calls the surgery's landline during opening hours, speaks to a real person, and books the appointment verbally; will not use any web form.
voice: Formal and articulate, peppered with Italian expressions like 'che caos'; speaks slowly and enunciates clearly.
